name: Sentin8
tagline: A Secure, Post-Quantum-Safe Enterprise Platform That Automatically Heals and Scales, Built for Regulated Industries.
pillarsLead: Every service - platform or vertical - inherits the five pillars by construction, not configuration.

pillars.title: Post-quantum cryptography, exclusively
pillars.summary: Every TLS connection negotiates X25519MLKEM768 with ML-DSA-65 certificate signatures, anchored by an SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s root CA. No classical fallback exists.

pillars.title: One identity plane
pillars.summary: Sentin8:Auth is the only token issuer, JWKS authority, and authentication authority. No service mints its own credentials - no second issuer to compromise.

pillars.title: Live authorization - Shield
pillars.summary: RBAC + ABAC + ReBAC decided per request. Roles are never embedded in tokens: a demoted administrator loses access on the next request.

pillars.title: Mandatory tenant isolation
pillars.summary: Every tenant table FORCE-RLS'd; no role carries BYPASSRLS. PostgreSQL runs the same certificate identity as the service plane - no database passwords exist.

pillars.title: Certificate-only workload identity
pillars.summary: A workload's only identity is its Acme-issued client certificate. No client secrets, no static API keys, no password files anywhere.

units.name: Sentin8:Auth
units.summary: The identity plane: OAuth 2.1/OIDC/FAPI issuer, JWKS authority, token families, SCIM, wallet credentials, lockout & bot protection.

units.name: Sentin8:Acme
units.summary: The internal ACME certificate authority: PQ server/client leaf minting, the root CA, enrollment claims, revocation.

units.name: Sentin8:Proxy
units.summary: The single ingress: L4 SNI router + L7 bridge; every connection PQ-TLS-terminated and round-robined across healthy instances.

units.name: Sentin8:Bus
units.summary: The durable event backbone: local outbox + produce API, Valkey Streams, consumer groups, DLQ, SSE consume.

units.name: Sentin8:DB
units.summary: SQL execution & data service over Sentin8-authorized queries - no direct database access from apps.

units.name: Sentin8:Storage
units.summary: Object storage: S3-compatible buckets, presigned upload/download, tenant-scoped prefixes.

units.name: Sentin8:Post
units.summary: Multi-channel message delivery: email, SMS, push, webhooks - templated, idempotent, retry-scheduled.

units.name: Sentin8:Secrets
units.summary: Secret reference store & resolver - plaintext never lands in application tables; every credential is a pointer.

units.name: Sentin8:Sign
units.summary: Electronic signature ceremonies (AdES/QES): session-bound signer approval, provider gateway seam, append-only evidence, outbox events.

units.name: Sentin8:Stat
units.summary: Metrics & analytics: MemBus telemetry ingest, aggregation, dashboards for the platform's operational truth.

units.name: Sentin8:Func
units.summary: Standalone WASM execution: tenant-authored functions, idempotent by key, proxy-back for domain data.

units.name: Sentin8:Flow
units.summary: Durable workflow engine: multi-step sagas with compensation, declarative triggers, workflow state machines.

units.name: Sentin8:Cron
units.summary: Distributed scheduler: declarative schedule enrollment, one-shot deferrals, proxy-back execution.

units.name: Sentin8:AI
units.summary: The AI capability layer: embeddings, chat, completions, document ingestion - behind the same authorization pipeline as everything else.

units.name: Sentin8:Sys
units.summary: The control plane: orgs, environments, vertical enrollment, service enablement, audit ingestion, branding.

units.name: Sentin8:App
units.summary: Third-party app store & instance management: listings, installs, runtime context bootstrap for every app shell.

units.name: Sentin8:BFF
units.summary: Backend-for-frontend & delegation gateway: OAuth tokens held server-side, session cookies to clients, scope downscoping.

units.name: Sentin8:Web
units.summary: The single Flutter web static host: runtime app discovery, same-origin bootstrap proxy, SPA fallback, COOP/COEP.

starters.name: sentin8-cli
starters.summary: Platform bootstrap & enrollment: db bootstrap, vertical init/enroll, captain control, catalog plumbing.

starters.name: Sentin8:Captain
starters.summary: Process supervisor: health-gated tier spawning, rolling zero-downtime upgrades, fleet placement, provisioning backends.

apps.name: Sentin8:Dash
apps.summary: The pure rendering host for every RFW admin UI - zero compile-time vertical knowledge.

apps.name: Sentin8:Auth-UI
apps.summary: The identity app: sign-in/up, consent, wallet binding, branding-aware user flows.

sdks.name: sentin8 Rust SDK
sdks.summary: The shared workspace: core/identity/TLS/bus/shield/shell crates + the `sentin8` namespace facade. Consumed as a pinned git tag.

sdks.name: sentin8 Flutter SDK
sdks.summary: The one Flutter package: bootstrap, Bff8ApiClient, shell, theme, RFW renderer - native + web from a single import.
